Requirement: Agent should connect to enterprise systems like ERP, HR, Procurement, DMS, Data Lake etc.
Existing code: S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, SAC and M365 adapters.
Required update: Confirm entity-specific systems and DMS/data-lake coverage; do not equate configured plugins with verified connections.
Acceptance / evidence: Authenticated system inventory, ownership/security matrix and a sourced cross-system demo.

Requirement:
Agent should translate executive questions into backend queries and return consolidated, permissioned, and sourced
answer
Existing code: Agent instructions route natural language to registered business tools.
Required update: Add repeatable intent-to-query checks, permission tests and consolidated answers across adapters.
Acceptance / evidence: Paraphrased executive questions return the correct scoped query, values, period and sources.

Requirement: Agent should have the capability to identify and connect with multiple systems, wherever required based on the nature of the query, to provide a correct / appropriate response
Existing code: Multiple plugins are packaged in the executive agent.
Required update: Verify joins and consistent entity, period, currency and authorization across systems; no general cross-system query coordinator established.
Acceptance / evidence: Demonstrate budget versus actual by division using actual source calls and one correlation trace.

Requirement: Source system should be consistently displayed against information returned by the agent
Existing code: M365 evidence envelopes and source instructions exist.
Required update: Require verified claim-level sources throughout; evaluation generates fallback document IDs without fetching proof.
Acceptance / evidence: Every material fact links to a real source/snapshot; absent evidence is explicitly unverified.

Requirement: Agent controls access to data / information based on user persona
Existing code: Verified identity, consent and role/scope mechanisms exist.
Required update: Bind Facilitator tenant, actor, roles and scopes to verified identity; REST currently forwards body arguments to handlers.
Acceptance / evidence: Cross-role and cross-tenant negative tests fail closed through REST and MCP transports.

Requirement: Materially similar requests should produce substantively consistent outputs irrespective of phrasing or timing
Existing code: Deterministic calculations and versioned rules exist.
Required update: Add paraphrase regression tests with pinned source snapshots and reporting periods; changing live facts can legitimately change answers.
Acceptance / evidence: Same scope, period, source version and policy produce equal material facts across phrasings.

Requirement: Agent activity should be logged, including systems queried and sources accessed
Existing code: Dataverse audit clients and correlation fields exist.
Required update: Verify durable read-call logging across SAP, SAC, M365 and consolidated requests; collect source-access exports.
Acceptance / evidence: Trace a cross-system request from user identity to each provider call and retained source snapshot.

Feature: Connection to internal and external data
Requirement:
Agent continuously scans internal data (KPIs, finance,
operations, HR) or external signals (markets, regulations,
peer jurisdictions, media) in the background
Existing code: KPI snapshots, rules and scan helper exist.
Required update: Wire scheduled source refresh into evaluation; worker only dispatches outbox and briefing subscriptions. Add approved external signals where required.
Acceptance / evidence: A scheduled run fetches fresh internal/external inputs and records evaluated sources without a user prompt.

Requirement: Agent automatically identifies risks and opportunities and shares it with executive, without being asked
Existing code: Threshold rules generate recommendations from supplied snapshots.
Required update: Schedule KPI acquisition and evaluation, not only notification dispatch.
Acceptance / evidence: A changed source KPI autonomously creates and delivers an alert; retain 30 consecutive days of real logs.

Requirement: Recommendations should be appropriately categorized into risks / opportunities / benchmarks, based on its nature
Existing code: Risk/opportunity categories supported.
Required update: BENCHMARK rules are deliberately skipped until comparable data exists; constrain categories to agreed business taxonomy.
Acceptance / evidence: Risk, opportunity and benchmark scenarios produce correctly categorized sourced alerts.

Requirement: Agent should provide automated recommendations through a daily alerts feed, push notifications, or an end-of-day digest
Existing code: Durable notification outbox and email dispatch are implemented.
Required update: Prove scheduled delivery, correct recipient and recovery in the deployed environment; email meets one permitted channel.
Acceptance / evidence: Live alert email/feed plus provider receipt, deduplication and restart recovery evidence.

Requirement: Agent captures feedback from Executive on the relevance  / usefulness of each alert issued (capturing risk / opportunity / benchmark)
Existing code: Per-alert useful/not useful feedback, type, identity and persistence logic.
Required update: Verify executive UI wiring and evidence export.
Acceptance / evidence: Executive submits a rating; record remains associated with original alert, category and identity.

Requirement: Source system should be consistently displayed against information returned by the agent
Existing code: Recommendations carry claims, sources and confidence.
Required update: Verify source rendering and prevent unverified supplied snapshots being treated as provider evidence.
Acceptance / evidence: Alert displays original KPI source, reporting period, scope and freshness.

Requirement: Time stamped comprehensive logs of recommendations issued by the agent should be maintained showcasing that the engine operates autonomously
Existing code: Recommendation/outbox history and subscription run records exist.
Required update: Include scheduled scan executions, workload identity and fresh input lineage; export real autonomous history.
Acceptance / evidence: 30-day categorized recommendation log links source acquisition, evaluation and delivery timestamps.

Requirement:
Agent ingests any proposal, strategy, business case,
budget submission, or expenditure request
Existing code: Structured vendor-option evaluation exists.
Required update: Add document ingestion and evaluation for strategies, business cases, budget submissions and expenditure requests.
Acceptance / evidence: Evaluate representative documents from each requested class with linked extracted evidence.

Requirement:
Agent produces a structured evaluation against the following criteria:
a. strategic priorities
b. fiscal impact
c. peer benchmarks
d. historical precedent
Existing code: Approved vendor policy scores technical, commercial and historical performance.
Required update: Add explicit strategic priorities, fiscal impact and comparable peer benchmarks across evaluation types.
Acceptance / evidence: Versioned framework covers all four criteria and records missing inputs explicitly.

Requirement:
Output should include the following for each evaluation:
a. alignment score
b. financial impact
c. comparable cases
d. identified risks
e. open questions for the executive to probe
Existing code: Vendor rankings, weighted scores, claims and rationale are returned.
Required update: Add complete alignment score, fiscal impact, comparable cases, risks and executive questions schema.
Acceptance / evidence: Every evaluation exposes all five required sections, using unavailable states where evidence is absent.

Requirement: Output produced by the agent should be consistent every time
Existing code: Deterministic vendor scoring and historical decision retrieval.
Required update: Extend repeatability to broader evaluation scope and fixed evidence/policy versions.
Acceptance / evidence: Repeated and paraphrased evaluations of frozen inputs produce consistent scores and facts.

Requirement: Agent shows a confidence level at the front end (for the executive to view) for evaluations and data points
Existing code: Confidence framework and evaluation confidence fields exist.
Required update: Remove automatic HIGH/VERIFIED assumptions for caller-supplied technical and commercial facts; verify display in executive UI.
Acceptance / evidence: Missing/unverified/stale inputs lower confidence; executive can inspect evidence-based reasons.

Requirement: Time stamped comprehensive logs to showcase working of the evaluation engine should be maintained
Existing code: Vendor decision persistence and signed export.
Required update: Extend logs to all evaluation types and collect actual usage history.
Acceptance / evidence: 30-day evaluation log with repeated-case evidence, policy versions, input snapshots and outcomes.

Feature: Sync with Executive's emails and other platforms
Requirement:
Agent reads the executive's calendar, inbox, or relevant
files
Existing code: Calendar, mail, Teams, Planner and transcript read code.
Required update: Verify per-executive mailbox binding and relevant file retrieval; instructions alone do not prove SharePoint/DMS integration.
Acceptance / evidence: Authenticated executive-specific calendar, inbox and file examples with permission-denial cases.

Requirement:
Agent automatically produces pre-meeting briefs,
end-of-day digests, or a triaged inbox view ranking what
needs attention
Existing code: Morning, pre-meeting, EOD synthesis and inbox triage; worker subscription dispatch.
Required update: Validate configuration and deployed schedule, and resolve worker mailbox issue before multi-executive rollout.
Acceptance / evidence: Real pre-meeting and EOD artifacts are created automatically at configured times.

Requirement:
Briefs can be attached to every calendar invite the
night before or digests landing at the end of each day
Existing code: Email briefs and configurable pre-meeting lead time.
Required update: Calendar attachment/night-before invite workflow not found. EOD email is implemented but requires live acceptance.
Acceptance / evidence: Demonstrate requested invite attachment/night-before behavior or formally accept scheduled EOD email delivery.

Requirement: Briefs should contain references to underlying emails, meetings or documents where applicable
Existing code: Briefings contain source collections and attributed claims.
Required update: Ensure links resolve to underlying emails/events/documents, not just generic Graph API collection endpoints.
Acceptance / evidence: Open underlying evidence from the executive briefing with the same access permissions.

Requirement: Time stamped comprehensive logs to showcase automated generation and delivery of briefs, including delivery timing should be maintained
Existing code: Subscription run history captures content hash, scheduled occurrence and provider receipt.
Required update: Export real generation/delivery timing and distinguish provider acceptance from final inbox delivery.
Acceptance / evidence: Scheduled-versus-actual generation and delivery evidence for pre-meeting and EOD runs.

Requirement:
Through a simple natural-language interface, the
executive describes a recurring task to the agent
Existing code: Natural-language agent can expose fixed automation subscription tools.
Required update: Add recurring-task interpretation into a validated executable sub-agent specification.
Acceptance / evidence: Executive describes a new recurring task and receives an editable agent specification.

Requirement:
Agent builds, deploys, and maintains a sub-agent to handle it based on the natural language request (non-technical).
No code, no IT ticket, no procurement cycle.
Existing code: Fixed briefing subscriptions are a reusable foundation.
Required update: No general build/deploy/maintain sub-agent runtime found; current executive instructions explicitly avoid child agents.
Acceptance / evidence: A natural-language request creates and deploys a versioned sub-agent without developer intervention.

Requirement: Sub-agents run autonomously on schedule or trigger to complete the Executive's tasks
Existing code: Worker runs predefined scheduled briefing kinds.
Required update: Add generic sub-agent job execution and event triggers with scoped authorization, retries and telemetry.
Acceptance / evidence: Newly created agent completes a scheduled and an event-triggered run autonomously.

Requirement: Executive can edit, pause, or retire sub-agents at any time with a simple interface
Existing code: Prepare/confirm/revoke subscription operations.
Required update: Implement agent edit, pause, resume and retire UI/API plus versioned authorization changes.
Acceptance / evidence: Executive changes schedule/task, pauses it, resumes it and retires it; no runs occur while paused/retired.

Requirement: Time stamped comprehensive logs showcasing sub-agents created based on executive's request should be maintained
Existing code: Subscription records preserve authorization and configuration.
Required update: Add actual sub-agent creation, deployment and lifecycle audit records.
Acceptance / evidence: Trace executive request to deployed agent ID, version and authorization.

Requirement: Logs showcasing successful runs of sub-agents
Existing code: Subscription run history exists.
Required update: Add sub-agent run inputs, outputs, success/failure and external action receipts.
Acceptance / evidence: Export successful and failed runs for an executive-created sub-agent.

Requirement: Agent indexes every meeting, decision, document, and email the executive engages with, building a permanent, searchable record of context, rationale, and outcomes
Existing code: Vendor institutional records and explicit chat JSONL ingestion.
Required update: Add permission-aware ingestion/indexing of meetings, decisions, documents and email; no comprehensive indexer found.
Acceptance / evidence: New content becomes searchable with provenance, context and applicable retention/deletion controls.

Requirement: Agent leverages institutional memory and provides answers with original context, participants, and supporting documents
Existing code: Vendor history retrieval supports original evidence, time coverage and scope.
Required update: Generalize retrieval to executive topics, participants, decisions and outcomes across all content types.
Acceptance / evidence: Historical query retrieves original participants, rationale, outcome and accessible supporting documents.

Requirement: Original source documents should be provided by agent
Existing code: Vendor records retain source_doc_ref and source hashes.
Required update: Provide retrievable original documents for general memory and verify links/ACLs.
Acceptance / evidence: Executive opens authorized originals; revoked documents disappear from retrieval.

Requirement: Timestamped comprehensive logs should be maintained to showcase how the agent used institutional memory in its thinking process
Existing code: Vendor decisions retain consulted institutional evidence.
Required update: Log general memory retrieval IDs, versions and contribution to a concise decision rationale.
Acceptance / evidence: Export a trace showing which historical records informed the answer; no private internal chain of thought needed.

Requirement: Agent automatically joins virtual meetings
Existing code: Existing transcript retrieval is available.
Required update: No automatic virtual meeting join/attendance implementation found.
Acceptance / evidence: Meeting invite triggers permitted attendance and produces usable captured meeting evidence.

Requirement: Agent automatically joins in-person meetings
Existing code: User-supplied transcript/notes path is available.
Required update: No in-person audio capture, transcription or meeting participation integration found.
Acceptance / evidence: Approved in-person capture creates speaker-attributed transcript and traceable minutes.

Requirement: Agent produces and circulates accurate minutes including decisions and action items with named owners and deadlines
Existing code: Action extraction, owner resolution, approved Planner tasks and summary-email draft tools.
Required update: Complete accurate minutes generation and circulation; Facilitator calendar workflow currently returns SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.
Acceptance / evidence: Transcript/notes produce reviewed minutes, decisions, named owners and deadlines, then receipt-backed circulation.

Requirement: Agent follows up autonomously until each item closes (owners can receive nudges as deadlines approach)
Existing code: Reminder evaluator checks Planner status and due dates.
Required update: Wire evaluator into scheduled dispatch; ACTION_REMINDER is schedulable but unsupported by worker dispatch switch.
Acceptance / evidence: Autonomous nudges occur before/after deadline, deduplicate and stop on completion.

Requirement: Agent produces live tracker of what's outstanding across all meetings
Existing code: Live tracker reads mapped meeting actions and synchronizes Planner completion.
Required update: Prove coverage of all in-scope meetings and correct access boundaries.
Acceptance / evidence: Tracker shows owners, deadlines, overdue state and provider-updated completion across meetings.

Requirement:
Agent pulls comparable data from peer entities, peer
jurisdictions, or international benchmark sources based on the KPIs defined for comparison
Existing code: PeerBenchmarkRecord storage schema exists.
Required update: No functioning peer-data acquisition/comparability service or external benchmark source integration found.
Acceptance / evidence: Integrated approved peer datasets with source inventory, dates, units and cohort definitions.

Requirement: Agent presents comparisons with peers based on the KPIs aligned with the Executive
Existing code: Peer storage fields and card template exist.
Required update: Build KPI/cohort selection, normalization and comparison calculation service.
Acceptance / evidence: Internal KPI compared with valid matched peer cohort and period; incomparable data rejected.

Requirement: Data source should be consistently shown to the executive at the front end, for each data point
Existing code: Benchmark datasource field and generic EvidenceSource contract.
Required update: Populate verified per-datapoint peer provenance and render it.
Acceptance / evidence: Each internal/peer value exposes a retrievable source, period and transformation history.

Requirement: Agent provides confidence level to each data point based on a defined framework
Existing code: Reusable comparability-aware confidence framework.
Required update: Apply it to real peer values; storage/template alone does not establish confidence.
Acceptance / evidence: Confidence reflects peer freshness, coverage and comparability with visible reasons.

Requirement: Benchmarks can be automated or on demand
Existing code: Generic worker/outbox could be reused.
Required update: Add on-demand benchmark tool and/or scheduled benchmark service; benchmark recommendation branch currently skips execution.
Acceptance / evidence: A real on-demand or automatic benchmark request returns a sourced comparison.

Requirement: Facts of the benchmarks / comparisons should be the same for the same KPI & period
Existing code: Version field exists on benchmark storage.
Required update: Build deterministic comparison over immutable KPI/peer snapshots and frozen definitions.
Acceptance / evidence: Same KPI, cohort, period and dataset version always produce identical comparison facts.

Requirement: This capability applies to Proactive Recommendation Engine, Evaluation Engine and Peer Benchmarking. It applies to decisions / recommendations / evaluations performed by the agent.
Existing code: Vendor decision manifests and recommendation evidence contracts.
Required update: Apply one trace/export contract across recommendations, general evaluations and peer benchmarking.
Acceptance / evidence: A sample from each capability can be reconstructed from an export.

Requirement: Agents' output should be accompanied by reasoning chain in non-technical & easy to understand language i.e. rationale why a decision was taken. Executive should have the option to expand an answer to see why it was given
Existing code: Vendor concise rationale/calculation trace; decision card exists.
Required update: Wire an expandable executive explanation panel; current decision card has only metadata and no expand action.
Acceptance / evidence: Executive expands Why this result to see criteria, calculations, evidence and limitations in plain language.

Requirement: Data source should be consistently shown to the executive at the front end, for each data point
Existing code: Claim source references and decision manifests.
Required update: Reject fabricated fallback document references; standardize source display across all decision-producing tools.
Acceptance / evidence: Every decision fact is traceable to an actual original or retained provider snapshot.

Requirement: Agent provides confidence level to each data point based on a defined framework
Existing code: Versioned confidence model with source reliability/comparability factors.
Required update: Evaluate confidence from evidence rather than unconditional HIGH/VERIFIED values, and show it per material point.
Acceptance / evidence: Missing, stale and incomparable evidence demonstrably changes displayed confidence.

Requirement:
Complete audit trial should be logged in a way that decisions can be reconstructed by auditors. Logs should include the following aspects:
a. identity: user identity also including agents & its versions where applicable (user id, user role, timestamp) and unique decision ID
b. provenance: which data sources were used to generate the output
c. attribution: which person, model, source, or system contributed to the decision (ERP, SharePoint, Agent, User etc.)
d. rationale: why a particular recommendation / decision was provided
e. exportable: logs should be exportable
Existing code: Vendor manifests contain actor, policy, input snapshots, rationale and export.
Required update: Bind actor/tenant/roles to verified identity; extend signed exports across capabilities with actual agent/model versions.
Acceptance / evidence: Auditor reconstructs identity, input versions, contributors, rationale and outcome without caller-controlled attribution.

Requirement: Logs should be tamper proof
Existing code: Hash/signature verification and application-level mutation guards.
Required update: Remove fallback signing secret; use managed key custody and independently enforced immutable retention. SQLite/application checks do not make logs tamper-proof.
Acceptance / evidence: Alteration/deletion attempts by app and storage administrators are prevented or independently detected; key rotation and retention verified.
